|strategy=By [mailto:arltm@umich.edu Martin Arlt]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/tatooine/light/small/jediescape.html</ref>

Let's face it, there are a lot of new dueling-related cards in this set, ranging from all-in-one duelers like [[Darth Maul]] to cards to help out [[Epic Duel]], like [[Vader's Anger]]. That's all fine, if you're ready to play a dueling deck. But what if your Jedi would rather battle aliens in Mos Espa, rather than go head-to-head with a Dark Jedi? Should you have to stock your deck with all the dueling helper cards, just in case?

The answer to that is "no." There are several cards in the [[Tatooine]] expansion that are useful for avoiding duels. If you don't want your Jedi to duel, just keep one or two copies of [[Jedi Escape]] handy, along with a little saved-up Force. Now when your opponent tries to duel your Jedi away with [[Darth Maul]] or [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]], just flash this card at him, use one force, and cancel the duel. You can then even move your characters at the site away to prevent him from battling you.

But beware, [[Jedi Escape]] is not immune to [[Sense]]. If you really want to avoid the duel, you'd best make sure to include an [[Alter]] or [[Control (Coruscant){{!}}Control]] in your deck. It's not that big a hardship, though, as both of these cards have their uses outside of protecting [[Jedi Escape]].
